versions: cvf-zhang19-stfcsl (ICCV 2019, CVF open access; only version in the wiki; no arXiv preprint found by title in the index)
population: One filtered population for all topics (tools/pop.py, adapted from the shared lip-reading decoder builder): index rows with a camera modality whose title or ledger names lip reading, VSR, LRW, LRS2/3 or speechreading and whose ledger names a model; titles naming surveys, reviews, datasets/corpora, perception, enhancement or separation, synthesis or video-to-speech, talking faces, forgery, synchronisation, keyword spotting or challenges removed; perception, neuroimaging, education and non-decoder rows removed on reading (tools/exclude_reading.json, 49 + 20 ids); versions grouped by ledger key plus a merge list (12); target removed. 514 groups: prior 120, [concurrent] 25, date unresolved 2, [later] 367. Hand check of the prior list: two neuroscience/perception rows found and removed; two duplicate pairs merged.
setting: Lip-reading, VSR and AVSR decoders, word or sentence level, any signal-boundary inside camera input; novelty precedents counted from the same population (all are video decoders).

inherited.M01: Voiced broadcast and TED speech video (GRID, LRW, LRS2, LRS3)
inherited.M03: ImageNet-pretrained front end; LRW + LRS2/LRS3 pre-train sets, then fine-tuning; length curriculum of Chung et al. 2017
inherited.M11: Benchmark splits; GRID random split of LipNet (overlapped speakers)
inherited.M13: Single 12 GB GPU; training days only

topics.inclusion_rule: Lip-reading decoders of the shared population with a learned convolutional front end, classified by how the per-frame feature map is reduced before the temporal model, as their full text states it (snippets of every prior and [concurrent] hit read): pooling to a per-frame vector (global average pooling or a ResNet pooled output), a fully connected layer over the spatial map (including flatten then project), or spatial or spatiotemporal attention/pyramid modules in the front end. Boundary: hand-crafted features (DCT, PCA, AAM) and fully connected networks on raw pixels without a convolutional front end are excluded; related-work mentions are not designs; versions once.
topics.metric: LRW word error (100 - top-1) and LRS2/LRS3 WER with GAP against the alternative, same back end

topics.inclusion_rule: Published rule kept. For this review: the 120 prior and 25 [concurrent] decoders of the shared population, classified by full-text pattern (reference list removed) and reading of every prior hit for a temporal-convolution sequence model (spatiotemporal front-end convolutions excluded), a convolutional encoder-decoder with attention, Transformer self-attention, and self-attention restricted to a local width. Boundary: temporal convolutions used only in a pretraining stage are counted separately; mentions are not designs; versions once.

Published rule kept. For this review: decoders of the shared population that report visual-only results on LRS2 or LRS3 and are first public before 2019-04, read for whether each reported row states its external-LM condition, whether both conditions are given, and run spread; plus the best prior LRW result without word boundaries and the best prior GRID result, to check the target's Table 3 rows against their sources.
topics.metric: LRS2/LRS3 WER with LM condition; LRW error; GRID WER
